split_unit: Complete source CycleIndex blocks; all pulse, rest and multisine samples within a cycle stay together
fit_sequence: Steps 12,13,14,15 (both HPPC pulses and complete intervening/following rests), preceded by the last 10 seconds of step 11 for state initialization. No thinning or random timestamp split.
additional_assessment: The following multisine step 17..21 and complete step 22 rest, simulated continuously after the HPPC sequence with no voltage reset.
loaded_curve: All OCVDis samples are independent input characterization for that same cell. They are low-rate loaded voltage, not equilibrium OCV.
soc: Coulomb count positive-discharge CurrentData using observed C/20 integral; initial HPPC SOC proxy=1 is an explicit assumption. Assessment currents may be inputs; their voltages never enter fitting or model selection.
voltage_reference: Piecewise-linear correction to the C/20 loaded curve using only calibration cycles' final 10 s of pre-pulse rest. Not a proven equilibrium OCV map. Assessment baseline voltages are not used to initialize predictions.
models: same reference minus constant R0*I and one RC polarization state
current_hold: left endpoint zero-order hold; instantaneous ohmic voltage uses current sample. Sensitivity to right-endpoint hold reported separately without selecting using assessment results.
one_rc_selection: At least 20 percent reduction in development-cycle HPPC sample RMSE, interior positive R0/R1/tau, and the calibration tau-profile's 5-percent-SSE support must exclude both search bounds. This is a complexity/identifiability screen, not engineering acceptance or a confidence interval.
uncertainty: Enumerate all 4^4 whole-calibration-cycle bootstrap draws (256, including repeats), refit on a fixed log-tau grid; report 2.5/97.5 percentile conditional intervals. Only four calibration cycles, same cells/rig, no sensor uncertainty budget. Report tau SSE profile and normalized sensitivity conditioning separately.
temperature: No temperature law fitted. Report recorded surface-temperature ranges by split; nominal chamber characterization is 23 C.
assessment_policy: Freeze fitted artifacts and selected model before first assessment scoring. No fitting, correction, model selection or thresholds based on assessment voltages. This is within-cell held-sequence assessment, not independent module validation.
module_final_assessment: Existing configs/splits.json and splits.lock.json remain unchanged; no reserved module traces are accessed.
